@graph.name: Martin Spatovaliyski
@graph.description: Passionate front-end developer and project owner with over six years of experience leading the charge for multiple product launches, excelling in WordPress integrations, and specializing in UI/UX engineering. Proficient in JavaScript, React, and Headless integrations, I breathe life into interfaces and possess a good eye for great design and the big picture.

content.rendered:
Revamped web tools, pages, and the marketplace with a keen eye for visual enhancement. Took ownership of several internal tools and public-listed website, making creative decisions to elevate its overall appeal, ensuring a seamless and engaging user experience.

▪ Developing and maintaining the WooCommerce marketplace WordPress marketing platform;
▪ Developing and maintaining the internal tools built on React and TypeScript;
▪ Initiated a campaign and executed a visual rebrand for the Coffee startup’s Marketplace and
public web platform look as well as the internal Inventory & Trading platforms;

@graph.name: Martin Spatovaliyski
@graph.description: Passionate front-end developer and project owner with over six years of experience leading the charge for multiple product launches, excelling in WordPress integrations, and specializing in UI/UX engineering. Proficient in JavaScript, React, and Headless integrations, I breathe life into interfaces and possess a good eye for great design and the big picture.

content.rendered:
I successfully integrated a well-established platform into WordPress, overseeing the seamless migration of content, user data, and media. I crafted custom templates and plugins to deliver a distinctive user experience, complemented by refined Locomotive and GSAP animations. Additionally, I implemented robust user management, authentication, and content moderation for a secure and professional WordPress environment.

▪ Migration to a new CMS, which hosts over 9000 teachers and 180+ school profiles;
▪ Led the complete end-to-end rework of the movie association’s platform, transitioning it to a new
environment, using WordPress, and bringing it up to 2022 standards. Implemented a custom-built
Theme from scratch as well as Custom Post Types utilising ACF;
▪ Applied several custom modifications to the WPAdmin as well as migrated all content from 2009
up to 2022.
